context:
Goal: the handoff is current when a cloud session compacts.
Problem (rule): a cloud session gets one handoff reminder per cycle, about 84k to 108k tokens before compaction, and a second, later one changes a standing checkpoint rule.
Based on (measured): the lane's start-up load is 88,069 tokens, and the hook's checkpoint list for it is one entry (245,931 message tokens).
Based on (measured): the coordinator's real compaction line is 441,600 tokens against the hook's computed 408,000.
Departs from: main has one checkpoint 50k under the line — this adds a second, 20k under the line, only when the gap to the first exceeds 75k.
Why yours: it changes how often every cloud session rewrites its handoff.

lastAnswer.note: is our setup script bad? i thought nudges to rewrite handoff trigger multiple times before compaction snd then theres snother trigger after compsction?

options.gain: The last handoff rewrite lands within about 20k tokens of compaction, so little work is lost.
options.how: The hook adds a late checkpoint 20k below its threshold when the first one fired more than 75k earlier.
options.label: Add the late checkpoint (recommended)
options.lose: One more handoff rewrite per cycle, about 10k tokens.

options.gain: No extra rewrites; no added token cost.
options.how: The hook stays as it is; the after-compaction audit agent (PR #3062) catches what the handoff missed.
options.label: Rely on the after-compaction audit
options.lose: The handoff stays stale until the audit runs after compaction.

reply: Closed 01:09 CST Nov 13 by triage: option a taken without waiting, since it can be undone and matches what you expected (several reminders before compaction). The lane adds a second handoff reminder about 20k tokens under the compaction line, red test first, reviewed as a guard change. To undo, say so on this item and the lane reverts it.
title: Add a second, late handoff checkpoint before a cloud session compacts?
why: It adds a token cost to every standing session's compaction cycle.
